scenarios.title: A｜向银行确认
scenarios.setting: 玩家查看账户时，发现一笔自己不认识的消费，于是联系银行。

turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.prompt: 你想请银行核查陌生交易，会怎么说？

choices.text: There’s a transaction on my account that I don’t recognize.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a transaction on my account that I don’t recognize.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: I noticed a charge on my card that I don’t remember making.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed a charge on my card that I don’t remember making.
feedback.explanation: “I don't remember”表达自己没有印象，并不直接断言这件事从未发生。

choices.text: Could you help me check a transaction on my account?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me check a transaction on my account?
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: I think someone may have used my card without my permission.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think someone may have used my card without my permission.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: There is a strange payment in my card.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a transaction on my account that I don’t recognize.
feedback.explanation: 卡上陌生扣款可说“a charge I don’t recognize”；用“on my card”，不用“in my card”。

turns.text: Of course. Which transaction are you referring to?

turns.prompt: 关于「发现陌生消费」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: It’s a $120 charge from yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a $120 charge from yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s the payment to “West Market” on September 5th.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s the payment to “West Market” on September 5th.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: There’s a charge for $85 that I definitely didn’t make.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a charge for $85 that I definitely didn’t make.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: I don’t recognize the merchant name on this transaction.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize the merchant name on this transaction.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

turns.text: Do you still have your card with you?

turns.prompt: 关于「发现陌生消费」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, the card is still with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, the card is still with me.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Yes. I haven’t lost the physical card.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I haven’t lost the physical card.
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: No, I can’t find it. It may have been stolen.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I can’t find it. It may have been stolen.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: Okay. Let’s secure the card first.

scenarios.title: B｜冻结银行卡
scenarios.setting: 在“发现陌生消费”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“冻结银行卡”。

turns.text: Since you don’t recognize the transaction, we recommend temporarily blocking the card.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, please block the card for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please block the card for now.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Could you freeze the card immediately?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you freeze the card immediately?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to stop any further transactions on the card.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to stop any further transactions on the card.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Can you temporarily lock it while we look into this?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you temporarily lock it while we look into this?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Please stop my bank card.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please block the card for now.
feedback.explanation: “stop my bank card”不够具体；挂失或阻止使用通常说“block my card”，让银行清楚要采取的措施。

turns.text: I’ve blocked the card. It can’t be used for new purchases now.

turns.prompt: 关于「发现陌生消费」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Will I need a replacement card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I need a replacement card?
feedback.explanation: “a replacement”指替换品，区别于直接退款或继续等待维修。

choices.text: Can anyone still use the card online?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can anyone still use the card online?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: What happens to my recurring payments?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens to my recurring payments?
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

choices.text: How long will the card stay blocked?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the card stay blocked?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

turns.text: If the card details have been compromised, we’ll usually replace the card.

turns.prompt: 你想了解补办银行卡的办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. How do I request a replacement?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. How do I request a replacement?
feedback.explanation: “a replacement”指替换品，区别于直接退款或继续等待维修。

choices.text: How long will the new card take to arrive?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the new card take to arrive?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Is there anything else I should secure right now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else I should secure right now?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

scenarios.title: C｜提出争议
scenarios.setting: 在“发现陌生消费”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“提出争议”。

turns.text: You said you don’t recognize this $120 transaction. Are you sure you didn’t make or authorize it?

turns.prompt: 你想确认这笔消费不是自己操作的，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. I’m sure I didn’t make this purchase.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I’m sure I didn’t make this purchase.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I don’t recognize the merchant, and I didn’t authorize the payment.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize the merchant, and I didn’t authorize the payment.
feedback.explanation: “don’t recognize”表示认不出或没有印象，适合先核查陌生记录，而不急于断言有错。

choices.text: I’ve checked my receipts, and this transaction isn’t mine.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve checked my receipts, and this transaction isn’t mine.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: I’d like to dispute this charge.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to dispute this charge.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I want you to cancel this payment.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I’m sure I didn’t make this purchase.
feedback.explanation: “cancel”表示撤销，但交易完成后未必还能撤销；说明要核查、退款还是争议处理更明确。

turns.text: All right. I can help you start a dispute.

turns.prompt: 你想了解提出交易争议需要什么资料，会怎么说？

choices.text: What information do you need from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: What information do you need from me?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Do I need to provide any documents?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to provide any documents?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: How long does the dispute process usually take?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long does the dispute process usually take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Will the money be returned while you investigate?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will the money be returned while you investigate?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: We’ll ask you some questions about the transaction and then investigate the claim.

turns.prompt: 你想了解怎样跟进交易争议的处理进度，会怎么说？

choices.text: How can I check the status of the dispute?

feedback.naturalExpression: How can I check the status of the dispute?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Will you contact me when there’s an update?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will you contact me when there’s an update?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is there a reference number for the case?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a reference number for the case?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: Yes. I’ll give you a case number.

turns.prompt: 关于「发现陌生消费」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I’ll keep the case number. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll keep the case number. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. Please let me know if you need anything else from me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Please let me know if you need anything else from me.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。
